title: SQL comment bodies are never redacted; literals after an injected -- or inside /* */ leak in clear
claim: sqlSensitiveToken ignores sqllexer COMMENT/MULTILINE_COMMENT tokens, so in the canonical exploit ' OR TRUE -- the application-owned tail (e.g. password = '81dc9bdb...') and any /* ... */ content are emitted verbatim in evidence, contrary to the shared cross-tracer redaction corpus and dd-trace-java/js behavior. analyzer_test.go:30 pins the unredacted behavior.
repro_command: go test -count=1 -run TestHostileSQLCommentBodiesAreRedacted -v ./internal/taint/redaction/ ; end-to-end: woven hostile app GET /exploit?param=%27%20OR%20TRUE%20-- (see leak-excerpts.txt, spans-woven.json)

title: Sink analysis, evidence building and stack capture run for every tainted query after the per-request quota is full

title: Retroactive source redaction builds patterns from byte length, exceeding the 250-character truncation limit
